setting.activity: Driving to a local comic convention

agent.name: Gwen
agent.style: Distracted, talking through pins in mouth, crafty

speaker_b.name: Harper
speaker_b.style: Patient but strictly focused on traffic

dialog.input_text: Okay, the panel for the new animated show starts exactly an hour after doors open. We have to rush to the main hall immediately.
Are you kidding? I need to hit the vendor floor first before all the exclusive variant covers sell out.
We can split up. I'm not missing that panel. The voice actors are doing a live reading.
Hey, watch the hot glue gun in the passenger seat! I just felt something warm near the center console.
dialog.agent_text: Oh, shoot, sorry! I'm just trying to reattach this foam armor piece before we arrive. The glue dripped.

dialog.input_text: Just don't glue it to my upholstery, please. This car is leased.
dialog.agent_text: I promise I'm being careful! I have a piece of cardboard underneath it.

dialog.input_text: Will your costume even be dry enough to wear by the time we get to the security line?
dialog.agent_text: It dries super fast. As long as I hold it still for the next ten minutes, it'll be solid.

dialog.input_text: Alright, but we are not waiting in the lobby for you to fix it if it snaps again.
dialog.agent_text: It won't snap! Have a little faith in my craftsmanship.
